text: 万象知识库是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的本地知识管理插件。它可把选定会话整理为笔记与知识卡片，也支持导入 Markdown、文本、代码文件、文件夹和 ZIP；检索提供 exact、hybrid 与 deep 模式，并能按摘要、概览和分页正文逐步读取。插件提供知识搜索、正文读取、项目时间线和工具目录查询工具，以及关系图谱和侧边栏工作台。用户还可从会话文件夹学习资料、登记工具并启用可选自动召回；模型整理和召回使用 Harness 配置的模型，知识正文和索引保存在本地。

Wanxiang Knowledge Base is a local DeepSeek Harness plugin for saving sessions and imported files as searchable notes. It offers search, paged reading, a timeline, tool catalog, graph, and workspace panel. Optional folder study and automatic recall use the configured model.

万象知识库的功能「会话归档」：将选定会话整理成笔记或知识卡片，也可选择原文导出。通过工作台生成操作触发，结果写入本地知识库并建立索引。
万象知识库的功能「文件夹学习与导入」：从当前会话绑定目录整理文件，或导入 Markdown、文本、源代码、文件夹和 ZIP。通过 /wanxiang study 或导入面板触发，产出本地知识条目。
万象知识库的功能「知识搜索」：按查询词搜索本地条目，支持 exact、hybrid、deep 模式。可选择摘要层级，并查看命中来源与有效状态。
万象知识库的功能「分页读取正文」：按知识 ID 读取正文和关联条目。每页最多 12000 字符，返回 nextOffset 供继续读取。
万象知识库的功能「项目时间线」：按项目和更新时间列出知识标题与摘要，可分页浏览有效且未归档的条目。
万象知识库的功能「工具目录查询」：搜索已登记工具的名称、类别、说明和检测状态，并可关联知识条目。
万象知识库的功能「可选自动召回」：在用户确认并启用后，为会话提示词提供已就绪的知识片段；检索未及时完成时跳过该步。
万象知识库的功能「工作台与侧栏」：从 Harness 主面板、侧栏入口或快捷浮层打开知识库界面，查看和管理知识内容。
万象知识库使用 AI 整理会话或学习文件夹时，会将相关文本交给 Harness 当前配置的模型；自动召回也可能把知识摘要加入模型提示词，按功能设置启用。

万象知识库是为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 开发的社区插件。它在 Harness 内提供会话落库、本地检索、可选自动召回、知识图谱、工具目录和文件夹学习，支持构建属于你的专属Agent：当前 AI 可以通过 `/wanxiang` 查询已有知识，也可以按需读取摘要、正文和项目时间线。

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · alpha.10 更新：- 图谱按稳定快照分页加载全部真实节点，修复大库突然缩成紫色簇、绿色方法点被遮盖的问题。
- 长知识正文支持完整分页读取，Markdown 支持本地图片、表格和附件链接，附件通过鉴权接口访问。
- 修复导入附件路径的特殊字符编码，提升文章完整标题的检索排序。
- 工作台顶部直接展示可点击的 GitHub 项目完整网址。

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 在 Harness 中使用：截图展示的是已导入知识和配置了工具环境的实际工作台；条目数、关系数和可用工具数随本地数据变化，安装插件不会自动获得截图中的全部工具。

| 让当前 AI 使用以前的知识 | 输入 `/wanxiang 问题`，保持当前会话模型和权限，由 AI 查询知识后回答 |

| 管理常用工具 | 按类别登记工具、查看环境检测状态、关联使用方法；宿主工具能力另行发现 |

/wanxiang study

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 斜杠菜单也可选择 /wanxiang-study：```

学习当前会话绑定目录中的支持文档与源代码，使用设置里选择的整理模型，保留文件来源，完成后更新检索和图谱。网络或模型失败可以继续，已完成文件的整理缓存会复用。普通文件导入直接保存内容，不调用模型。

<details>
<summary>查看导入面板与支持范围</summary>

- 支持 Markdown、UTF-8 文本与声明的源代码/配置扩展名、文件夹和 ZIP。
- 支持相对引用与 Obsidian `[[双向链接]]`；原生内容包校验清单及 SHA-256。
- 相同内容跳过，同 ID 不同内容保留两份并映射引用，保留手工修改。
- 单批最多 2000 文件、64 MiB；单文档/附件最多 2 MiB。不支持加密 ZIP、分卷和 ZIP64。
- PDF、Word 和图片目前作为附件保留，不提取 PDF/Word 正文，也不提供 OCR。

</details>
dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 会话落库：回合结束后登记到「待落库」，点击「生成到本地」才开始整理。可选 AI 整理或无需模型的原文导出；会话新增消息生成独立增量记录，不覆盖旧笔记。长会话会按上下文大小自动分段处理，不设分段数量硬上限；实际耗时和模型用量随会话长度增加。AI 整理模型可跟随来源会话，也可在设置里明确选择。

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 中文召回与渐进读取：检索以本地 `node:sqlite + FTS5` 为主，结合中文预分词、两字词、条目问法 `questions[]` 与本地别名表，补强中英混合、错误码和自然语言问法。没有嵌入模型依赖，当前向量检索为 **Off**。

| 模式或层级 | 适用场景 |
| --- | --- |
| `exact` 精确检索 | 路径、错误码、卡片 ID 和原文片段 |
| `hybrid` 混合检索 | 精确候选与 FTS 结果融合，利用标题、摘要和问法排序 |
| `deep` 深度检索 | 扩展到正文，显示正文命中片段 |
| `L0 → L1 → L2` | 先读短摘要，再读概览，最后按需读取正文，控制上下文体积 |

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 中文召回与渐进读取：模型工具包括 `knowledge_search`、`knowledge_read`、`knowledge_timeline` 和 `tool_catalog_search`。搜索默认返回 L0，完整标题优先，并分散同一来源的拆分条目。`knowledge_read` 每页最多读取 12,000 字符；返回 `nextOffset` 时，用同一 ID 和该偏移继续，直到 `nextOffset=null`。偏移基于脱敏后的正文。条目附稳定 ID、关联条目、来源、更新时间和有效状态，便于核对和追溯。

详情面板支持库内图片、附件下载和表格；知识条目间的链接可打开目标详情。附件接口检查访问令牌、正文引用和来源目录范围，非图片文件以下载方式提供。

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 可选自动召回：自动召回提供 **关闭 / 仅提示 / 自动注入** 三档。自动注入必须先确认知识摘要会发送给宿主模型；未确认时不开始注入。

检索在可终止的独立 SQL 子进程中运行。单槽预算 150ms、搜索总预算 190ms、缓存外层预算 200ms；同步提示词 section **只读取已就绪缓存**，不等待检索、不读取正文、不调用模型。未就绪或超时就跳过该步，优先保证会话继续。日志支持查看引用、反馈有用/无用，以及屏蔽条目或项目。

**当前自动注入仍属实验能力。** 检索页合成评测与自动注入策略是不同口径：开发阈值 `0.65` 在固定合成策略集上的漏召率为 **76.25%**，真实历史留出评测与正式阈值尚未完成，不能用检索页 Recall@5 替代自动注入质量。

<details>
<summary>查看模型与召回设置</summary>

文件、索引和规则检索保存在本机。AI 整理、文件夹学习、元数据补全和经确认的自动注入会按所选功能将相关文本或摘要发给 Harness 配置的模型；智能查询改写是独立可选项，默认关闭。

</details>

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 知识图谱与活动：球体与网络两种布局展示真实知识节点；支持类型图例、标题/标签筛选、旋转、拖拽、重置和导出 PNG。图谱不设条目总量硬上限，通过稳定快照每批加载 1,000 条，持续加载至全部完成；超过 1,500 或 5,000 条时不会缩成少数簇，也不会统一变紫色。节点列表按批展开，球体保留全部节点与原始类型颜色；大图降低普通连线密度并按视野绘制，选中和活动关系仍可查看。网络布局按需初始化。已用 50,001 条合成节点验证完整加载、搜索与定位；实际帧率仍取决于设备和数据规模。

蓝色知识节点在发生已记录的读取、落库或实际注入时短暂变为柠檬黄。**活动表示知识被访问，不表示模型已经采纳结论。** 工具目录与知识图谱分开呈现。
dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 性能实测：性能报告同时给出范围和代价：下面是本机合成数据测量，不是所有资料、机器或模型的性能承诺。复现命令、原始 JSON 与局限见 [性能与架构说明](docs/performance.md)。

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 性能实测：| 实测项目 | 结果 | 测量范围 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 中文混合检索合成评测 | 80 个查询，Recall@5 **100%**，MRR **0.98125** | 20 条固定合成知识 |
| 10 万条原生 FTS 查询 | p50 **0.75ms** / p95 **85.20ms** | 原生磁盘索引，含宽泛词；不含模型和完整服务 |
| 10 万条隔离自动召回 | p95 **91.27ms**，40/40 未超时 | RecallSearch + IPC + 规则/置信度，含冷启动 |
| 10 万条驻留 Map | 堆内存 **716.90 → 181.02 MiB**，约降低 **74.7%** | 全正文与仅元数据两种驻留方式；非应用总内存 |
| 百万条压力测试 | FTS p95 **844.68ms**；隔离召回 **20/40 超时** | 宽泛检索和预算限制 |
| 当前代码验证 | 构建、类型检查、**80/80 测试通过** | 本机验证，不代表所有宿主版本均兼容 |

自动召回的截止预算用于限制开销，超时会放弃注入。

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 架构与数据：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[DeepSeek Harness 会话与命令] --> B[万象插件服务]
    C[本地文件与 ZIP] --> B
    B --> D[结构校验 / 去重 / 来源 / 任务恢复]

| 架构选择 | 实际收益与边界 |
| --- | --- |
| 原生 Harness 插件 | 接入会话、命令、工具与提示词扩展点，在宿主内完成查询和沉淀 |
| Markdown 是正文来源 | 可以直接阅读、编辑与备份；索引可删除重建，知识不锁在数据库内 |
| 原生 SQLite + FTS5 | 本地持久检索；能力缺失自动降级到 sql.js，并提示规模限制 |
| 正文按需加载 | 常驻 Map 主要保留元数据，减少大正文的 JS 堆占用 |
| SQL 子进程隔离 | 超时后终止查询进程；代价是冷启动和额外进程内存 |
| 分片、修订与发布清单 | 笔记按年月、卡片按项目组织；支持异常恢复、冲突拒绝和整理撤销 |
| 渐进披露与来源标识 | 先摘要再正文，控制送入模型的内容量，并保留可核对的来源 |

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 架构与数据：新版本维护顶层兼容副本供旧版读取，副本会增加磁盘占用；两侧内容同时修改时拒绝静默覆盖。目录整理与撤销前先预检、备份，不能据此保证任意断电情况下都可恢复。

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 工具库与分析扩展：工具库按类别显示登记的工具、环境检测状态和知识关联。绿色表示检测可用，注册状态与环境状态独立显示，不能把「存在接口」当作「环境已安装」。

可选安全分析扩展接入 PE/ELF、反汇编、字符串、已有流量文件、APK/DEX、.NET、YARA 等能力。**这些组件需要额外安装与配置，不随插件安装包捆绑全部工具。** 具体接口、安装方法和运行边界见 [安全分析工具库](docs/security-tools.md)。

cd wanxiang-knowledge
npm ci

默认知识目录为用户 Documents 下的「万象知识库」，可在设置中切换。插件设置保存于 `<DSH_HOME>/wanxiang/settings.json`。桌面开发安装脚本还要求设置 `WANXIANG_HOST_URL` 为本机 Harness 地址，以核对会话/任务空闲并完整备份；见 [安装脚本](scripts/install-desktop.mjs)。

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 可选知识内容包：[knowledge/](knowledge/README.md) 提供 **1182 条知识正文**，包括逆向基础、漏洞机制、系统底层、VM、密码算法，以及固定版本的 OpenSSL、LLVM/Clang、QEMU 技术文献。中文机制归纳与英文文献正文分别标注，来源、哈希和适用许可随内容保留。

内容包不会在安装插件时自动写入你的个人库。可从「导入知识库」选择内容包文件夹，或使用 `scripts/import-reverse-knowledge.mjs --root <知识库绝对路径> --source <内容包绝对路径>`；重复内容跳过，冲突拒绝覆盖。文献收录和结构校验不等于逐篇代码实测。

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · 当前边界与参与：- 当前主要验证 Windows + Harness Desktop `0.2.1-alpha.1`，其他平台/宿主版本需进一步测试。
- 尚无向量检索、OCR、PDF/Word 正文解析、云同步或多用户协作。
- 自动召回的真实历史质量、正式阈值与生产首步覆盖率仍待评测；百万条完整 Markdown 与应用全链路性能尚未验收。
- 模型整理的结论需要结合来源核验；分析扩展也不是恶意样本沙箱。

欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/Minglink/wanxiang-knowledge/issues) 提交可复现问题，或提交改进检索、图谱与兼容性的 PR。请使用脱敏的最小示例，不上传私人会话、凭据或业务样本。

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Introduction：Wanxiang Knowledge is a community plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It turns conversations and project material into reusable local knowledge, with conversation archiving, local search, optional automatic recall, a knowledge graph, a tool catalog, and folder learning. The command asks the current AI to retrieve information through the plugin's knowledge tools. Without an explicit question, it can use the current conversation's question. It does not switch to another model.

Folder learning reads supported documents and source files from the current conversation's bound directory, uses the organization model selected in settings, retains file provenance, and updates search and the graph. dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Archive conversations locally：Completed turns are registered in the pending archive list. Organization starts when you click the local-generation action. Choose AI organization or a model-free raw export. New messages produce separate incremental records rather than overwriting existing notes. Long conversations are split automatically to fit the context budget, with no hard limit on the number of segments; elapsed time and model usage increase with conversation length. The organization model can follow the source conversation or be selected explicitly in settings.

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Chinese-aware search and progressive reading：Search primarily uses local `node:sqlite + FTS5`, with Chinese pre-tokenization, two-character terms, entry-specific `questions[]`, and a local alias table for mixed-language queries, error codes, and natural-language questions. No embedding model is required; vector search is currently **Off**.

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Chinese-aware search and progressive reading：| Mode or level | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `exact` | Paths, error codes, card IDs, and literal text fragments |
| `hybrid` | Merge exact candidates with FTS results, ranking by title, summary, and question variants |
| `deep` | Search full text and display matching body snippets |
| `L0 → L1 → L2` | Read a short summary first, then an overview, then full text only when needed to control context volume |

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Chinese-aware search and progressive reading：Model tools include `knowledge_search`, `knowledge_read`, `knowledge_timeline`, and `tool_catalog_search`. Search returns L0 by default, and body reads have length limits. Entries include stable IDs, provenance, update times, and validity status for verification and traceability.

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Optional automatic recall：Recall has three modes: **Off / Hint only / Automatic injection**. Automatic injection requires explicit confirmation that knowledge summaries will be sent to the host model.

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Optional automatic recall：Retrieval runs in a terminable SQL child process, with a 150ms per-slot budget, a 190ms total search budget, and a 200ms outer cache budget. The synchronous prompt section **only reads ready cache entries**: it does not wait for retrieval, read bodies, or call a model. A step is skipped when results are not ready or time out. Logs support inspecting references, marking results useful/unhelpful, and blocking entries or projects.

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Optional automatic recall：**Automatic injection remains experimental.** Search-page evaluation and injection-policy evaluation measure different things. At the development threshold of `0.65`, the fixed synthetic policy set has a **76.25% miss rate**. Real-history holdout evaluation and a finalized threshold are still pending. Search Recall@5 must not be treated as injection quality.

<summary>Model and recall settings</summary>

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Optional automatic recall：Files, indexes, and rule-based retrieval stay local. AI organization, folder learning, metadata completion, and confirmed automatic injection send relevant text or summaries to the model configured in Harness. Model-assisted query rewriting is separately optional and disabled by default.

</details>

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Knowledge graph and activity：Sphere and network layouts visualize relationships, with type legends, title/tag filtering, rotation, dragging, reset, and PNG export. Knowledge details and graph nodes support navigation in both directions. The graph loads every real node through stable 1,000-node pages, without a configured total-node cutoff or replacement by aggregate nodes. Type colors remain visible, including rare method and pitfall nodes. The node list expands in batches; rendering uses viewport culling and adaptive frame pacing. Complete loading and search were verified with 50,001 synthetic nodes; frame rates depend on hardware and library size.

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Knowledge graph and activity：Blue nodes briefly turn lemon yellow when a read, archive, or actual injection event is recorded. **Activity means knowledge was accessed, not that the model adopted its conclusions.** The tool catalog is presented separately from the knowledge graph.

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Measured performance：These are local synthetic measurements, not guarantees for every corpus, machine, or model. Reproduction commands, raw JSON, and limitations are in the [performance report (Chinese)](docs/performance.md).

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Measured performance：| Measurement | Result | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chinese hybrid retrieval | 80 queries, Recall@5 **100%**, MRR **0.98125** | 20 fixed synthetic entries; not a real-history holdout |
| Native FTS, 100,000 entries | p50 **0.75ms**, p95 **85.20ms** | Disk index, including broad terms; excludes model and full service |
| Isolated recall, 100,000 entries | p95 **91.27ms**, 40/40 without timeout | RecallSearch + IPC + rules/confidence, including cold startup |
| Resident Map, 100,000 entries | Heap **716.90 → 181.02 MiB**, about **74.7% lower** | Full-body versus metadata-only retention; not total application memory |
| One-million-entry stress test | FTS p95 **844.68ms**; isolated recall **20/40 timed out** | Exposes broad-query costs and deadline limits |
| Current code verification | Build, type checking, **80/80 tests passed** | Local verification, not compatibility with every host version |

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Measured performance：Recall deadlines bound overhead by abandoning timed-out injection. They do not guarantee successful retrieval at every scale. The two scale benchmark suites ran concurrently on the same Windows machine with Node.js v24.19.0, so contention may affect results.

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Architecture and data：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[DeepSeek Harness conversations and commands] --> B[Wanxiang plugin service]
    C[Local files and ZIP archives] --> B
    B --> D[Validation / deduplication / provenance / job recovery]

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Architecture and data：| Design choice | Benefit and tradeoff |
| --- | --- |
| Native Harness plugin | Integrates conversations, commands, tools, and prompt extension points within the host |
| Markdown as the body source | Read, edit, and back up files directly; rebuild indexes without locking knowledge inside a database |
| Native SQLite + FTS5 | Persistent local search; falls back to sql.js when unavailable, with scale warnings |
| On-demand body loading | Keep mostly metadata in the resident Map to reduce JavaScript heap usage |
| SQL process isolation | Terminate timed-out queries at the cost of cold startup and additional process memory |
| Sharding, revisions, and publication manifests | Organize notes by month and cards by project; support recovery, conflict rejection, and reorganization undo |
| Progressive disclosure and provenance | Send summaries before full text and retain sources that can be checked |

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Architecture and data：Top-level compatibility copies support older readers and consume additional disk space. Conflicting edits on both sides are not silently overwritten. Reorganization and undo perform preflight checks and backups; this does not guarantee recovery from every possible power failure.

```text
Knowledge directory/
├─ notes/          Conversation notes
├─ cards/          Methods, pitfalls, and project cards
├─ sources/        Conversation excerpts and external sources

dsh-wanxiang-knowledge README · Current limitations and contributions：- Primarily validated on Windows + Harness Desktop `0.2.1-alpha.1`; other platforms and host versions need further testing.
- No vector retrieval, OCR, PDF/Word text extraction, cloud synchronization, or multi-user collaboration yet.
- Real-history automatic recall quality, a finalized threshold, and production first-step coverage remain unevaluated. A complete million-entry Markdown/application pipeline has not been validated.
- Model-organized conclusions need source verification. Analysis extensions are not a malware sandbox.
